ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOu.en: Those BIKERS ran off, and\nLOSTELLE was found safe.\pEverything turned out for the best!
ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOu.fr: Ces MOTARDS sont partis et LOSTELLE\nest saine et sauve.\pTout est bien qui finit bien.

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney.en: Hey, hey, lady!\nFork over some spending money!
ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney.fr: Hey ! Madame, t'aurais pas du\nliquide sur toi ?

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice.en: Aiyeeh!\pWh-who are you?!\nI… I'll call the police!
ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice.fr: Aaaah.\pQu-qui êtes-vous ? Je vais appeler\nla police moi, voyous !

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBiker.en: Those BIKERS…\nAre they gone?\pOh, thank goodness!\nThey certainly had me terrified!
ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBiker.fr: Ces MOTARDS… Ils sont vraiment\npartis ?\pOh, merci mon dieu ! Ils m'ont fait\nune peur bleue.

ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFede.en: We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION!\nVroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!\pMy bike's wimpy, so I have to\nmake exhaust noises myself!
ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFede.fr: On est les KANTO ANGELS ! Vroom !\nVavavavooom ! Vroom !\pLa honte, je dois faire le bruit de\nma bécane tout seul.
